cases.description: When the requested key is not present in collectorMap, the method should return null (collectorLoadMap is irrelevant because the first lookup yields null).
Key exists in collectorMap with a value that is NOT a Collector. The condition fails, so the original value from collectorMap is returned.

Key maps to an object that implements Collector, but collectorLoadMap does NOT contain a loaded value for that key (value is null). The method should fall back to returning the Collector instance from collectorMap.
Key maps to a Collector and collectorLoadMap holds a non‑null loaded value for the same key. The if‑branch is taken and the loaded value is returned, not the Collector itself.

collectorLoadMap contains a value for the key but collectorMap does NOT. Because the first lookup yields null, the instanceof check fails and the method returns null (the value in collectorLoadMap is ignored).
Calling get(null) when both maps are empty should return null (Map#get accepts null keys and returns null).

Key is empty string; collectorMap contains a plain (non‑Collector) value and collectorLoadMap also contains a value. Since the value in collectorMap is not a Collector, the method must return the plain value, ignoring the load map.
collectorMap holds a Collector instance, collectorLoadMap holds an explicit null for the same key. The load‑map check fails (null), so the Collector from collectorMap is returned.

collectorMap contains a null entry for the key, while collectorLoadMap contains a non‑null loaded value. Because the first lookup yields null (object is not a Collector), the method returns the null from collectorMap, ignoring the load map.
Both collectorMap and collectorLoadMap contain explicit null values for the key. The method returns null.

collectorMap holds a plain object (String) and collectorLoadMap holds a different value. Since the object is not a Collector, the method must return the plain value from collectorMap, ignoring the load map.
collectorMap holds a Collector instance, collectorLoadMap holds an Integer (non‑null). The method should return the Integer loaded value, demonstrating that the loaded value can be of any type.
